description: The Beaumaris waterfall walk is a delightful and often overlooked local amble that takes you into the peaceful Nant Meigan valley, a lush wooded area next to the town of Beaumaris. This walk offers a quiet escape from the busier coastal paths and the bustle of the Beaumaris Castle area. As you follow the path through this tranquil environment, you will discover the modest but charming Nant Meigan waterfall itself, a soothing spot perfect for a moment of quiet reflection and a great place to watch for local wildlife.The trail is short and easy to navigate, making it accessible for a gentle stroll. A unique historical aspect of this path is the presence of an old mill race that runs alongside the water; information boards in the vicinity explain how this channel once harnessed the power of the water to operate two local mills, adding a touch of industrial heritage to the natural beauty of the glen. It is a straightforward, pleasant walk that connects the town to a hidden natural gem.You can continue your walking in the area on theBeaumaris Castle and Coast Walkand theBeaumaris to Penmon Point Walk.
